title: Mayer–Vietoris sequence for modules on a ringed space
statement: Let X be a ringed space [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism], let U and V be open subsets with X=U\cup V, and let F be an O_X-module. Then there is a long exact sequence of abelian groups \(0\to H^0(X,F)\to H^0(U,F|_U)\oplus H^0(V,F|_V)\to H^0(U\cap V,F|_{U\cap V})\to H^1(X,F)\to\cdots\to H^{p-1}(U\cap V,F|_{U\cap V})\to H^p(X,F)\to H^p(U,F|_U)\oplus H^p(V,F|_V)\to H^p(U\cap V,F|_{U\cap V})\to\cdots\), where the maps are restriction and the difference of restrictions. The sequence is natural in F. If W'\subseteq X is open, then restricting the cover to U\cap W' and V\cap W' gives the corresponding sequence on W', and all restriction maps, including connecting maps, form a morphism of long exact sequences.

source.place: Cohomology of Sheaves, Lemma 01EB (cohomology-lemma-mayer-vietoris), statement and proof; restriction naturality follows from the proof's restriction of an injective resolution to an open

proof.text: Construct the square of the four section functors Gamma(U union V,-), Gamma(U,-), Gamma(V,-), Gamma(U intersection V,-) of [def-sc-open-module-cohomology], with section restrictions as its edges. Their square commutes by presheaf functoriality and uniqueness of inclusions of opens. Mathlib Opens.mayerVietorisSquare(U,V).sheafCondition_of_sheaf on the underlying abelian sheaf, composed with forget to types, gives injectivity of the section diagonal and gluing of any pair with equal restrictions. The equality c-d=0 is exactly equality of restrictions, so this proves kernel=image for every module. For an injective module use [lem-sc-ringed-space-injective-restriction-surjective] to get surjectivity of the difference. These three proofs construct an InjectivelyExactSquare of additive section functors.

Supply enough injectives using [lem-sc-ringed-space-module-sheaves-enough-injectives]. The generic resolutionSequence and transported boundary of [lem-sc-injectively-exact-square-resolution-short-exact] are explicit, with their short exactness already proved. For each section square use the object-variable naturality of [lem-sc-injectively-exact-square-boundary-naturality] to assemble the boundary components into a natural transformation. Apply [lem-sc-injectively-exact-square-boundary-exact] to obtain initial injectivity and the three exactness positions. The definitions in [def-sc-open-module-cohomology] identify deriving every vertex and edge with openModuleCohomology and openModuleCohomologyRestriction by definitional equality.

For each W construct a morphism from the square for U,V to the square for U intersection W,V intersection W, using restrictions at all four vertices. Every commuting face is proved in Lean using presheaf map_comp and uniqueness of inclusions. Apply the morphism-of-squares boundary naturality of [lem-sc-injectively-exact-square-boundary-naturality]. The two outer derived restrictions are definitionally the restrictions in the last equality, proving that equality for every U,V,W,p.
